name: Caramelo
englishDex: A caramel-coated street pup. When it trusts a Trainer, its tail lights a small, steady flame that never burns a friendly hand.

name: Caramelão
englishDex: It guards open-air markets. The embers across its back move like fleas and bite only those who try to steal.

name: Draguará
englishDex: Legends say every caramel dog that saves a life is reborn as Draguará. Its turquoise flames warm but never harm the innocent.

name: Querô
englishDex: It never fully sleeps. One eye watches its nest, and its quero-quero cry can echo for miles when danger approaches.

name: Queribela
englishDex: After its first molt, its feathers become iridescent dragonfly membranes. It hovers above water and hunts with exact precision.

name: Terolibra
englishDex: Four dragonfly wings support its slender lapwing body. A single wingbeat can launch a stream strong enough to split a trunk.

name: Pimpau
englishDex: Its soft beak drills bark for larvae. It trains by hammering dry stumps all day, then returns to its nest with a headache.

name: Bicopau
englishDex: Its beak hardens like ironwood. It drums complex rhythms on trees that other Bicopau understand as messages.

name: Petropico
englishDex: Its beak calcified into a granite wedge. It carves caves into stone cliffs with blows that ring like bells.
sourceInspiration: Pica-pau mítico com bico de granito

name: Formilim
englishDex: It is not a single ant, but an entire colony walking in the shape of a giant one. The colony scatters when threatened.

name: Saúvarco
englishDex: The queen of the leaf-cutter ants. It commands armies able to strip every leaf from a tree in one night.

name: Capivim
englishDex: It lives in riverside groups and lets any friendly POKéMON rest on its back, including tired Trainers.

name: Tucanhão
englishDex: Its huge beak is hollow and light. It swallows fruit whole and spits seeds far away, planting forests on its own.

name: Sagüim
englishDex: It steals anything that shines. Trainers quickly learn to keep their Gym Badges at the bottom of their bags.

name: Micuiras
englishDex: The elder of the Sagüim troop. It reads the future in river reflections and can predict rain a week ahead.

name: Boitatá
englishDex: It appears after wildfires. Its body is a blue flame-serpent that hunts those who deliberately burn the forest.

name: Curupim
englishDex: Its feet point backward. The tracks it leaves confuse hunters and guide them deeper into the forest.

name: Curupira
englishDex: The true lord of the forest. Wherever it steps, a century-old tree can rise in a single night.

name: Iaraço
englishDex: Its song enchants fishers. Those who follow it into the river are said to join its court forever.

name: Sacizinho
englishDex: It has only one leg and rides inside whirlwinds. It loves putting out campfires and teasing careless Trainers.
